exposure: Characteristics of dural puncture (e.g., number of attempts, needle size, patient position during puncture)
outcome: Worsening of headache in the upright position
cohort: The study included 26 pregnant women who developed post-dural puncture headache (PDPH) after receiving a subarachnoid block for obstetric indications.
finding: Post-dural puncture headache (PDPH) is a significant morbidity in parturients, and efforts should focus on prevention, prompt identification, diagnosis, and proactive treatment to minimize its duration and effects.
cross-section timing: At the onset of post-dural puncture headache
